name: Pan Seared Ribeye with Steak Sauce & Broccoli-Asparagus Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
3 small bunches asparagus
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a large bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the steak into portions, pat dry with paper towels, and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 2-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place ketchup, Dijon, Worcestershire, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, and crushed red pepper in a small bowl; whisk to combine the steak sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, juice lemons into the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates; drizzle sauce over steaks and enjoy!
